coordinate_transform.instrument_to_slab_local: subtract the selected Si layer center
coordinate_transform.slab_axis_meaning: local x is the 0.3-mm thickness axis; local y and z are the two 36-mm in-plane axes
coordinate_transform.world_to_instrument: subtract InstrumentFrame.Position, then apply inverse of InstrumentFrame.Rotation 0 45 0: x'=cos45*x-sin45*z; y'=y; z'=sin45*x+cos45*z

ordering.hits: numeric (time_s, layer, x_cm, y_cm, z_cm, edep_keV, source_csv_row) within each event

scope: All 10M SH3 events with Si_total>0 and upstream BGO_total<50 keV; raw Geant4 Si HITs only, before phonon/TES response

self_checks.nominal_boundary_excess_interpretation: Finite-decimal source-coordinate rounding only: all nominal excesses are on the 0.3-mm thickness boundary and remain below tolerance.

si_hit_catalog_10m.csv.nullable_field_note: primary_energy_keV is blank in every source HIT row; the flat output fills it by the composite event-key join to the event catalog
si_hit_catalog_10m.csv.row_granularity: one row per Si CC HIT energy-deposition record
si_hit_catalog_10m.csv.strict_recoil_definition: secondary starts with Si, parent neutron, creation_process hadElastic (materialized as is_si_elastic_recoil=1)
si_hit_catalog_10m.csv.units: energy keV; global position cm; time s
